title: 第2475章 我回来了第2474章 一步步往前走
slug: 太古神族第2477章秘境之变
lines: 虽说这套功法非同寻常，但哪怕再如何珍贵，相比圣宗庇护洛流香等人这么多年的恩情，却不值一提。
随着莫阳打出的光束没入他们眉心中，圣宗的几位强者都齐齐楞在原地，虽然他们修为算不上多强，但也能感受出来这段心法极其玄妙。
而且莫阳如今的修为他们根本无从揣测，只感觉强得可怕，莫阳拿出的功法，又岂能是寻常。
圣宗宗主愣了片刻后回过神来，第一反应便是要拱手道谢，因为他知道刚才那段功法对他乃至在场的几位圣宗强者而言乃是一桩天大的机缘。
不过尚未等他开口，莫阳便笑着摆了摆手，开口道：“宗主，这些年来多亏了圣宗照拂我的亲人朋友，一篇功法而已，又算得了什么。”
圣宗宗主到嘴边的话语被硬生生咽了回去，随后强压激动的心绪，重重点了点头，开口道：“是老夫矫情了。”
感受着脑海中那些玄妙至极的心法，几位圣宗的强者只是简单和莫阳说了几句，随后都迫不及待的腾空离去了，显然都是急着去参悟那段功法心诀了。
看着那几道急匆匆离去的身影，莫阳也转身离去，返回了道门圣女居住的院落中。
此次他来到荒域上，本不想在这里久留，只是如今洛流香还在闭关，而两个孩子也身在秘境，显然无法在短时间内返回玄天大陆了。
毕竟他荒域此行最主要的事情就是带洛流香等人返回玄天大陆。
因为莫阳到来的事情唯有圣宗内的极少数强者知晓，所以圣宗内一直很平静，眨眼过去了数日，哪怕季飞尘和徐青都有无数的话语和疑问想找莫阳，但他们也一直没有现身打扰莫阳。
毕竟莫阳已经离开了二十余年，在圣宗内的两位女子已经等了莫阳二十余年，这种时候，他们自然也不愿打搅莫阳。
莫阳时不时会前往洛流香所在的小院中查看情况，他来到圣宗的第七天，这天午时，洛流香所在的小院中忽然间波荡出一缕气息，直接穿透阵法逸散而出，将正在冥想的莫阳瞬间惊醒了过来。
不过莫阳嘴角随即便浮起一抹笑意，很显然是洛流香成功突破了，这比莫阳预料中提前了数日的时间。
莫阳睁开眼眸，身影一闪而逝，随即无声无息出现在洛流香所在的院落中。
洛流香虽然已经突破成功，但身躯依旧盘坐在那座阵法内，似是想趁此机会继续巩固新突破的修为。
不过此时她眉头忽然微微一蹙，似是心有所感，竟然腾的站起身来，随后睁眼看向院落的方向。
接着她身躯一颤，目光骤然凝固。
视线中，有一道身影默默负手而立，于她而言如梦如幻，以至于此时的她竟然下意识的去揉了揉眼睛，本能怀疑是自己出现了幻觉。
莫阳看着洛流香的反应，心中唯有一声轻叹，自己一走便是二十余载，如今归来，心中尽是愧疚。
不等莫阳多想，洛流香已经从那座阵法中走了出来，一步步朝他走来。
确定不是幻觉后，她当即红了眼眶，泪水已经模糊了双眼。
当初莫阳离开之时，她就知道莫阳可能会离去多年，但没想到莫阳一走便是二十余载，若是换成普通人，二十余年的光阴流逝足以让青丝染雪。
content_en:
Although this set of exercises is extraordinary, no matter how precious it is, it is nothing compared to the kindness that the Holy Sect has shown to protect Luo Liuxiang and others for so many years.
As the beam of light fired by Mo Yang disappeared into the center of their eyebrows, several strong men from the Holy Sect were stunned on the spot. Although their cultivation was not very strong, they could feel that this mental method was extremely mysterious.
Moreover, they had no way of guessing Mo Yang's current cultivation level. They only felt that it was terrifyingly strong. How could the skills Mo Yang used be ordinary.
The leader of the Holy Sect was stunned for a moment before he came to his senses. His first reaction was to express his gratitude because he knew that the exercise just now was a huge opportunity for him and even the powerful people of the Holy Sect present.
But before he could speak, Mo Yang waved his hand with a smile and said, "Sect Master, thanks to the Holy Sect taking care of my relatives and friends over the years, it's just a practice, it doesn't matter."
The words that came to the lips of the leader of the Holy Sect were swallowed back. Then he suppressed his excitement, nodded heavily, and said, "I am being pretentious."
Feeling the extremely mysterious mental methods in their minds, several strong men from the Holy Sect simply said a few words to Mo Yang, and then they all couldn't wait to leave in the air, obviously eager to understand the inner skills of that section.
Seeing those figures leaving in a hurry, Mo Yang also turned and left, returning to the courtyard where the Taoist Saintess lived.
This time he came to the wilderness. He didn't want to stay here for a long time, but now Luo Liuxiang is still in retreat, and the two children are also in the secret realm. It is obvious that he will not be able to return to Xuantian Continent in a short time.
After all, the most important thing during his trip to the wilderness was to take Luo Liuxiang and others back to Xuantian Continent.
Because only a few powerful people in the Holy Sect knew about Mo Yang's arrival, the Holy Sect had been very quiet. Several days passed in the blink of an eye. Even though Ji Feichen and Xu Qing had countless words and questions for Mo Yang, they never showed up to disturb Mo Yang.
After all, Mo Yang has been away for more than twenty years, and the two women in the Holy Sect have been waiting for Mo Yang for more than twenty years. At this time, they naturally do not want to disturb Mo Yang.
From time to time, Mo Yang would go to the small courtyard where Luo Liuxiang was to check on the situation. On the seventh day after he came to the Holy Sect, at noon, a wisp of breath suddenly rippled out of the small courtyard where Luo Liuxiang was, directly penetrating the formation and escaping, instantly waking up Mo Yang who was meditating.
However, a smile appeared at the corner of Mo Yang's mouth. It was obvious that Luo Liuxiang had successfully broken through, which was several days earlier than Mo Yang expected.
Mo Yang opened his eyes, his figure flashed away, and then appeared silently in the courtyard where Luo Liuxiang was.
Although Luo Liuxiang had successfully broken through, his body was still sitting cross-legged in the formation, as if he wanted to take this opportunity to continue to consolidate his new breakthrough.
But at this moment, she suddenly frowned slightly, as if she felt something in her heart, she stood up suddenly, then opened her eyes and looked in the direction of the courtyard.
Then her body trembled and her eyes suddenly froze.
In her sight, there was a figure standing silently with hands behind her hands. To her, it was like a dream, so much so that she subconsciously rubbed her eyes, instinctively suspecting that she was hallucinating.
Looking at Luo Liuxiang's reaction, Mo Yang could only sigh in his heart. It had been more than twenty years since he left, and now that he was back, he was filled with guilt.
Before Mo Yang could think about it, Luo Liuxiang had already walked out of the formation and walked towards him step by step.
After confirming that it was not an hallucination, her eyes immediately turned red and her eyes were blurred by tears.
When Mo Yang left, she knew that Mo Yang might leave for many years, but she didn't expect that Mo Yang would be gone for more than 20 years. If it were an ordinary person, the passage of more than 20 years would be enough to make her black hair dyed with snow.
